# Reef

> Reef (@Reefmetax on X) is a Community Builder in the Doginal Dogs and metax community. This site publishes daily crypto and Doginal Dogs, DDLTCG, and Pyth news, plus weekly articles.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://reefmetax.com/): Daily crypto updates and Doginal Dogs, Legends TCG, and Pyth news.
- [Articles](https://reefmetax.com/articles/): Plain-English write-ups on Doginal Dogs, crypto markets, and Pyth, written by Reef.
- [RSS feed](https://reefmetax.com/feed.xml): Article feed.

## Articles

- [Crypto Week in Review: Hot CPI, Bitcoin Under $74,000 and Square Switches On Bitcoin Payments](https://reefmetax.com/articles/crypto-week-in-review-nov-11-2026/): A plain-English wrap of the week to November 11, 2026: the October inflation surprise, a fast liquidation flush, rate hike odds, and real adoption news from Square, Visa and Pyth. No predictions, no calls.
- [Pyth's October 2026 Report in Plain English: $13.67M ARR, Treasury Curves and the Kalshi Midterms Index](https://reefmetax.com/articles/pyth-october-2026-report-explained/): What the numbers in Pyth's October 2026 report mean, what shipped across Pyth Pro and Pyth Indices, and how Pyth became the data source for Kalshi's KPOW Midterms index.
- [From Charlotte to Miami: The NC DDLTCG Tournament Recap and How the Dec 9 Championship Works](https://reefmetax.com/articles/charlotte-ddltcg-tournament-recap-miami-championship/): What happened at the Charlotte Doginal Dogs Legends pop-out on October 24-25, 2026, and what players need to know about the first official DDLTCG Championship in Miami on December 9.
- [Weekend Crypto Wrap: Bitcoin Tests $80,000 as Leveraged Longs Take the Hit](https://reefmetax.com/articles/weekend-crypto-wrap-oct-25-2026/): Prices, liquidations and ETF flows from the weekend of October 24, 2026, with sources. No predictions, no calls.
- [Pyth Network Explained: What a Price Oracle Is and How Pyth Works](https://reefmetax.com/articles/pyth-network-price-oracles-explained/): A newcomer's guide to price oracles, the push vs pull idea, and what changed in Pyth's setup after the August 26, 2026 upgrade.
- [Doginal Dogs 101: What Doginals Are and Why the Pack Cares](https://reefmetax.com/articles/doginal-dogs-101/): A plain-English intro to Doginals on Dogecoin, the Doginal Dogs collection, and why the community around it keeps growing.
